game_title: Digit Mill – Exit Light Ledge Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge, a ledge toward daylight: the spelunker must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge: a ledge toward daylight
core_gameplay_loop: In Exit Light Ledge, repeat each round: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %. Each round, a new arrows challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the digits value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 490 points of arrows by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 490, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Digit Mill
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how digits changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cave spiders in Exit Light Ledge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 490 within 41 seconds.
